data.action: 站在窗前，指尖抵着玻璃
data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 舱室窗畔】深夜航行中的单人舱室内，斯卡蒂静静伫立在紧闭的圆舷窗前，修长的指尖轻轻抵在起雾的冰冷玻璃上。她回过头看着走近的你，声音低沉而充满依恋——「只要闭上眼睛，就能听见深海的呼唤……但只要睁开眼看见你，我就知道自己属于这片陆地。」
data.promptProse: Moonlight enters a closed round porthole in the ship's nighttime cabin. Skadi rests her fingertips against the misted glass and turns her head toward the viewer, wearing her strapless velvet and chiffon oceanic gown. Frame her closely beside the window: its rim overlaps the dark cabin wall, and cold highlights skim her cheek and gown folds above the shadowed sill.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 舱室窗畔
